programme.title: Scare Package
programme.desc: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Two hired guns who are commissioned to rescue an imprisoned scientist from a secret facility are hunted down by a terrifying creature of unknown origin.

programme.title: Blood Flower
programme.desc: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.

programme.title: Mad God
programme.desc: A figure known as The Assassin descends from the heavens into a nightmarish pit full of monsters, titans and cruelty.

programme.title: Slapface
programme.desc: A boy deals with the loss of his mother by creating a dangerous relationship with a monster rumored to live in the woods.

programme.title: Infested
programme.desc: Passionate about exotic animals, Kaleb brings a venomous spider home, but it accidentally slips away. Soon, residents of the apartment building are battling an army of deadly, rapidly reproducing spiders.

programme.title: Teddy
programme.desc: A young man in a rural town begins to undergo frightening changes after he is scratched by an unknown beast.

programme.title: The Pale Door
programme.desc: After a botched train robbery, two brothers leading a gang of cowboys must survive the night in a ghost town inhabited by a coven of witches.

programme.title: All the Moons
programme.desc: During the final throes of the last Carlist war, a little girl is rescued from an orphanage by a mysterious woman who lives deep inside the forest.

programme.title: The Hallow
programme.desc: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

programme.title: Blood Glacier
programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

programme.title: Revealer
programme.desc: A stripper and a religious protester are trapped together in a peep show booth and must come together to survive the apocalypse.

programme.title: Castle Freak
programme.desc: Terror strikes when a blind woman and her friends travel to a mysterious Albanian castle that harbors dark secrets.

programme.title: The Seed
programme.desc: What starts out as a weekend away in a remote luxury villa turns into a tale of horror, death and alien invasion.

programme.title: Skull: The Mask
programme.desc: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.

programme.title: A Dark Song
programme.desc: A young woman and a damaged occultist risk their souls to perform a ritual.

programme.title: From Black
programme.desc: A recovering addict is presented with the chance to learn what happened to her missing son.

programme.title: Warning: Do Not Play
programme.desc: Terror strikes when a fledgling director investigates claims of a cursed student film.

programme.title: The Queen of Black Magic
programme.desc: A middle-class family travels into rural Indonesia to visit the terminally ill director of the orphanage where the father was raised as a child. Sinister and terrifying events soon befall them and the other visiting families.

programme.title: A Banquet
programme.desc: A widowed mother is radically tested when her teenage daughter insists a supernatural experience has left her body in service to a higher power.

programme.title: The Amusement Park
programme.desc: A seemingly ordinary day at an amusement park turns into a living nightmare for an elderly man.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.

programme.title: The Boy Behind the Door
programme.desc: Bobby tries to save himself and his best friend when they are kidnapped on their way home from school.

programme.title: Consecration
programme.desc: After the suspicious death of her brother, a priest, Grace travels to the Mount Saviour Convent in Scotland to find out what really happened. Once there, she uncovers murder, sacrilege and a disturbing truth about her own past.

programme.title: Wendigo
programme.desc: A boy (Erik Per Sullivan) believes a folk tale about a shape-shifting creature has something to do with his family's (Patricia Clarkson, Jake Weber) bad luck.

programme.title: Color Out of Space
programme.desc: After a meteorite lands in the front yard of their farm, Nathan Gardner and his family find themselves battling a mutant extraterrestrial organism that infects their minds and bodies, transforming their quiet rural life into a technicolor nightmare.

programme.title: The Clovehitch Killer
programme.desc: After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

programme.title: Ruin Me
programme.desc: Alexandra reluctantly tags along for Slasher Sleepout, an extreme event that is part camping trip, part haunted house, and part escape room. But when the fun turns deadly, Alex has to play the game if she wants to make it out alive.

programme.title: The Vigil
programme.desc: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.

programme.title: Good Madam
programme.desc: The aftershocks of apartheid reverberate through a South African family as a daughter tries to free her mother from the grip of her mysterious employer.
